verdict.rationale: Wise documents that businesses get global account details for receiving payments in 40+ currencies, which covers viewing account details. The evidence never mentions routing numbers explicitly or a bank verification letter. A community report says USD account details were changed with zero-day notice, which bears on the stability of those details but does not contradict that they can be viewed. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of viewing account/routing numbers in the dashboard, any documented bank verification letter generation, on-demand ('anytime') self-serve access, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can view account and routing numbers and generate a bank verification letter anytime

citations.quote: Get paid easily in other currencies with global account details.
